disposition: The initial v1 exception-masking finding was reproduced privately and corrected in this v2 tree. Missing-reference and sandbox getifaddrs gate attempts are setup failures, retained and excluded from positive evidence.

independent_review.retention_error_regression: Injected OSError is diagnosed while original CalledProcessError exit 23 survives.

limits: Retains test-build.jsonl only when the child created it; an earlier failure records a null hash. Preservation I/O can fail, but the original child exit remains authoritative and the failure is diagnosed. Hosted qualification and normal hook remain pending.
scope: Tooling-only best-effort staged child failure retention and private index write-tree; no production/API/coverage threshold changes.
